name: Quetzalcoatl

domain_history.domain: feathered-serpent deity associated with wind, knowledge/learning, and (in the Toltec-inherited strand) creation

notes: The popular "Moctezuma mistook Cortés for returning Quetzalcoatl" narrative is treated by leading current specialists as a post-conquest invention, not a contemporary pre-conquest belief — see claim_quetzalcoatl_cortes_myth_debunked. This is now mainstream/majority specialist opinion, not a fringe revision.
